name: mark_decision_candidates
title: Mark the offered decision candidates
description: Record the owner's verdict on the candidates you offered, in the owner's own conversation during an open owner request. All or nothing: one unknown item_id refuses the whole call with not_found. An item already marked can be marked again when the owner asks.

verdict.description: recorded: the owner said yes and the entry is in the decision log; declined: they said no, never offer it again; skipped: not a decision.

decision.description: The decision log entry number; only with recorded.
